question: Evaluate: 37 - [37 - {37 - (37 - 37 × 2)}]
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: 37 - [37 - {37 - (37 - 37 × 2)}]

**Formula used:**

Use BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

37 - [37 - {37 - (37 - 37 × 2)}]

⇒ 37 - [37 - {37 - (37 - 74)}]

⇒ 37 - [37 - {37 - (-37)}]

⇒ 37 - [37 - {37 + 37}]

⇒ 37 - [37 - 74]

⇒ 37 - (-37)

⇒ 37 + 37

⇒ 74

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
